requirements.requirement: EWMH 3.1 MUST: `_NET_SUPPORTED` ATOM/32 lists supported hints.
requirements.status_evidence: Verified for named profiles, I/A: exact 63 declared atoms, type/format, unique ordinary IDs.
requirements.remaining_acceptance: Retain exact-profile scope; table equality alone does not settle R02.

requirements.requirement: EWMH 3.1 MUST: advertised hints correspond to implemented behavior.
requirements.status_evidence: Review pending. A checks lookup/publication, not semantics of all 63 names.
requirements.remaining_acceptance: Check each advertised family against independent requests; preserve alias and failure-mode distinctions.

requirements.requirement: EWMH 3.10 MUST: root check identifies a WM-created child.
requirements.status_evidence: Implemented / unqualified. I checks WINDOW/32, one non-root ID, but does not independently query parentage.
requirements.remaining_acceptance: QueryTree must establish that the check window is a child of this root; test stale/foreign IDs.

requirements.requirement: EWMH 3.10 MUST: child check self-references and has WM name.
requirements.status_evidence: Verified for named profiles, I: self-reference and nonempty UTF8_STRING name.
requirements.remaining_acceptance: Replacement/stale-child handling is separate; branding remains RELEASE-01.

requirements.requirement: EWMH 3.2 SHOULD: client list preserves initial mapping order.
requirements.status_evidence: Verified for named profiles, I: three mapped clients, then destroyed-client removal.
requirements.remaining_acceptance: Broader startup adoption, withdrawn and transient cases remain unqualified.

requirements.requirement: EWMH 3.2 SHOULD: stacking list orders bottom to top.
requirements.status_evidence: Verified for named profiles, I: Raise changes order and dead IDs disappear.
requirements.remaining_acceptance: Independently check multiple layers, transient groups and restacking requests.

requirements.requirement: EWMH 3.3 SHOULD/conditional MUST: desktop count and accepted changes agree.
requirements.status_evidence: Implemented / unqualified. I verifies initial CARDINAL/32 count; `EWMH_SetNumberOfDesktops` uses effective count.
requirements.remaining_acceptance: Independent accepted/refused requests and consistent dependent publications.

requirements.requirement: EWMH 3.3 conditional MUST: shrink reconciles out-of-range desktops/windows.
requirements.status_evidence: Review pending. A command or count assertion is insufficient.
requirements.remaining_acceptance: Request shrink with current/populated high desks; observe current desk and each client property.

requirements.requirement: EWMH 3.5: viewport pairs describe each desktop.
requirements.status_evidence: Implemented / unqualified. `EWMH_SetDesktopViewPort` uses configured count, capped at 256.
requirements.remaining_acceptance: Test effective/configured disagreement and high desks; inspect actual property length and positions.

requirements.requirement: EWMH 3.9 MUST: work area contains a geometry per desktop.
requirements.status_evidence: Implemented / unqualified, reproduced gap I: one desktop and an empty work-area array.
requirements.remaining_acceptance: Repair count agreement with R07–R09; the inventory currently records this finding without failing.

requirements.requirement: EWMH 3.9 MUST/SHOULD: viewport-contained work area accounts for reserved edges.
requirements.status_evidence: Implemented / unqualified. `ewmh_SetWorkArea` publishes global monitor geometry; P tests internal struts separately.
requirements.remaining_acceptance: Foreign dock changes/removal, page shifts and topology must drive observable root geometry.

requirements.requirement: EWMH 3.6 MUST: current desktop stays within advertised range.
requirements.status_evidence: Implemented / unqualified. I verifies initial range only.
requirements.remaining_acceptance: Accepted/refused pager requests, timestamp-zero compatibility and shrink; do not infer from command Desk.

requirements.requirement: EWMH 5.17 MUST: CARDINAL[4]/32 reports each frame border.
requirements.status_evidence: Implemented / unqualified. I verifies four entries and horizontal/vertical size sums, not each edge.
requirements.remaining_acceptance: Translate client/frame root coordinates; distinguish left/right and top/bottom, including changed decorations.

requirements.requirement: EWMH 4.3 conditional: frame-extents request produces an estimate.
requirements.status_evidence: Planned. `_NET_REQUEST_FRAME_EXTENTS` absent in inspected tables and I output.
requirements.remaining_acceptance: Select adoption with EWMH-01; unmapped clients, absent hints, refusal and lifetime need independent cases.

requirements.requirement: Project validation: malformed properties/messages are refused safely.
requirements.status_evidence: Implemented / unqualified for the whole family. L retains bounded property cases; not every message field.
requirements.remaining_acceptance: Test format, signed/oversized values, source IDs and timestamps at each changed request owner.

requirements.requirement: EWMH 3.8: active-window publication and activation requests.
requirements.status_evidence: Implemented / unqualified. `ewmh_ActiveWindow` exists; command Focus is not a request oracle.
requirements.remaining_acceptance: Observe root focus plus property; distinguish request source/time, stale/dead clients and refusal.

requirements.requirement: EWMH 5.15/5.16: user-time hints and alternate time window.
requirements.status_evidence: Planned. Neither atom appears in inspected tables or I advertisement.
requirements.remaining_acceptance: Select focus policy before adoption; zero time, child death, wraparound and real application behavior.

requirements.requirement: EWMH 5.9: legacy strut uses four root-edge distances.
requirements.status_evidence: Implemented / unqualified for complete geometry. L malformed-property and P internal policy evidence remain narrow.
requirements.remaining_acceptance: Independent dock mutation/destruction and maximized placement with root-property readback.

requirements.requirement: EWMH 5.10 conditional MUST: partial strut overrides legacy strut.
requirements.status_evidence: Planned. `_NET_WM_STRUT_PARTIAL` absent from tables/I advertisement.
requirements.remaining_acceptance: Root coordinates, partial edge spans, both-property precedence, hotplug and malformed spans.

requirements.requirement: EWMH 6.3 conditional: fullscreen monitor selection uses four indices.
requirements.status_evidence: Planned. `_NET_WM_FULLSCREEN_MONITORS` absent from tables/I advertisement.
requirements.remaining_acceptance: Validate indices/topology generations and restore; command fullscreen does not establish this protocol.

requirements.requirement: EWMH 6.1 optional: ping correlates a client reply.
requirements.status_evidence: Planned. `_NET_WM_PING` absent from tables/I advertisement.
requirements.remaining_acceptance: If adopted, timestamp/window matching, unresponsive peers and bounded completion; no unsupported claim.

requirements.requirement: EWMH 6.2 optional: resize synchronization uses client counters.
requirements.status_evidence: Planned. `_NET_WM_SYNC_REQUEST` absent from tables/I advertisement.
requirements.remaining_acceptance: If adopted, negotiate counter ownership, ordering, timeout, counter replacement and client death.

requirements.requirement: ICCCM 4.1.7: focus models and TAKE_FOCUS timestamps.
requirements.status_evidence: Implemented / unqualified. Existing property validation does not qualify focus-model transitions.
requirements.remaining_acceptance: Four focus models with independent clients; actual server timestamps and client disappearance.

requirements.requirement: ICCCM 4.1.3.1/4.1.4: WM_STATE follows window lifecycle.
requirements.status_evidence: Implemented / unqualified. Legacy adoption and icon-state regressions cover narrower observations.
requirements.remaining_acceptance: Normal/Iconic/Withdrawn transitions, icon XIDs, remap/restart and destruction with independent property reads.

requirements.requirement: ICCCM 2.8/4.3: WM_Sn ownership is acquired and confirmed.
requirements.status_evidence: Implemented / unqualified. `SetupICCCM2` uses server time and confirms owner.
requirements.remaining_acceptance: Independent competing owner, multi-screen selection, refused acquisition and replacement race.

requirements.requirement: ICCCM 2.8 SHOULD: MANAGER announcement identifies timestamp, selection and owner.
requirements.status_evidence: Implemented / unqualified, source finding: only data slots 0/1 are assigned.
requirements.remaining_acceptance: Observe announcement before startup, verify slot 2 equals actual owner; initialize all event fields.

requirements.requirement: ICCCM 2.8 plus project bound: replacement releases old resources finitely.
requirements.status_evidence: Implemented / unqualified. Old-owner DestroyNotify wait has no deadline.
requirements.remaining_acceptance: Uncooperative/dead/replaced owner and raced destruction; bounded failure with descriptor/X ownership cleanup.

requirements.requirement: ICCCM 2.6.2 required: owner TARGETS conversion lists supported targets.
requirements.status_evidence: Verified for named profiles, L: legacy fixture reads exact four core targets via MULTIPLE.
requirements.remaining_acceptance: Direct conversion and ownership epochs remain unqualified; list equality is not target semantics.

requirements.requirement: ICCCM 2.6.2/4.3 required: TIMESTAMP and VERSION conversions return typed values.
requirements.status_evidence: Implemented / unqualified. `convertProperty` has both branches; L does not read their successful results.
requirements.remaining_acceptance: Direct INTEGER/32 values, lengths and acquisition epoch; repeat after replacement.

requirements.requirement: ICCCM 2.6.2 required: MULTIPLE preserves order and marks failed pairs.
requirements.status_evidence: Implemented / unqualified for complete target behavior. L covers malformed/empty pairs, unsupported/None results and TARGETS.
requirements.remaining_acceptance: Successful mixed targets, sequential conversion ordering, resource refusal and vanished requestor.

requirements.requirement: ICCCM 2.6.2 required: PRIMARY owner supports TARGETS/TIMESTAMP/MULTIPLE.
requirements.status_evidence: Implemented / unqualified, missing branches: Script PRIMARY handles only STRING.
requirements.remaining_acceptance: Add role-correct conversion, timestamps and failure replies while preserving stored configuration text.

requirements.requirement: ICCCM 2.1/2.3: PRIMARY acquisition and ownership loss are handled.
requirements.status_evidence: Implemented / unqualified. TextField uses event time; SelectionClear unselects text.
requirements.remaining_acceptance: Foreign owner replacement, stale acquisition, selection lifetime and request-after-loss.

requirements.requirement: ICCCM 2.5: replies correlate with the outstanding request.
requirements.status_evidence: Implemented / unqualified for the full correlation contract. The helper checks all five fields; L tests selected mismatches and late replies, not every field independently.
requirements.remaining_acceptance: Add wrong-selection replies as well as existing wrong-requestor/target/time/property cases; retain isolation and owner-change/flood limits.

requirements.requirement: ICCCM 2.5/2.7 plus project bound: receive typed, complete text.
requirements.status_evidence: Verified for named profiles, L: ordinary bounded UTF8/STRING, type/format/size refusal and recovery.
requirements.remaining_acceptance: Negotiated targets/encodings and incremental transfer remain outside these ordinary-property cases.

requirements.requirement: ICCCM 2.2/2.6.2: review private selection-owner target obligations.
requirements.status_evidence: Review pending. Script private messages implement custom targets and refusal, not generic target negotiation.
requirements.remaining_acceptance: Define this role's standard target responses without changing message ordering/bytes; do not claim clipboard ownership.

requirements.requirement: ICCCM chapter 3: cut-buffer consumer reads STRING/8.
requirements.status_evidence: Verified for named profiles, L: Form bounded paste and malformed/UTF8 boundary recovery.
requirements.remaining_acceptance: Not applicable with rationale to PRIMARY owner-target obligations: this consumer owns no selection.

requirements.requirement: ICCCM 2.5/2.7.2: requestor accepts incremental transfer.
requirements.status_evidence: Implemented / unqualified, unsupported path: INCR currently refused.
requirements.remaining_acceptance: Operation-local chunking, size/deadline bounds, zero terminator, cancellation and owner death.

requirements.requirement: Project bound: silent/dead selection peers cannot stall servicing indefinitely.
requirements.status_evidence: Verified for named profiles, L: finite helper refusal, stale requestors and high-descriptor coverage.
requirements.remaining_acceptance: Scope remains one bounded transfer; broader interaction/flood servicing needs owner fixtures.

requirements.requirement: Planned clipboard-manager role: persistence handoff.
requirements.status_evidence: Planned. No CLIPBOARD_MANAGER/SAVE_TARGETS service adopted.
requirements.remaining_acceptance: CLIPBOARD-01 selects revision, targets and protected lifetime; foreign clients must establish handoff before claims.

requirements.requirement: Planned native XDND participants: explicit source/target roles.
requirements.status_evidence: Planned. No native XDND event handlers found in the inspected core/modules.
requirements.remaining_acceptance: FILE-VIEW/SELECTION selects version and exact participants; managed toolkit clients keep their own roles.
